churches.name: Christ Anglican Church
churches.address: 840 Smyrna Powder Springs Rd, Marietta, GA 30060
churches.denomination_detail: Church of Nigeria North American Mission — Southeast Missionary Region Area 1, led by Bishop Celestine Ironna
churches.pastor_credentials: Bishop in the Church of Nigeria — CONNAM Southeast Missionary Region

score_notes.christology: Church of Nigeria upholds the Apostles', Nicene, and Athanasian creeds and historic Anglican Christology.
score_notes.scripture: Article VI of the 39 Articles affirms Scripture as containing all things necessary to salvation; Church of Nigeria is an outspoken defender of biblical authority worldwide.
score_notes.gender: Church of Nigeria / CONNAM restricts holy orders to qualified men only; one of the most vocal global-south Anglican provinces on this point.
score_notes.leadership: Episcopal polity under Bishop Ironna; male-only ordained orders.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformation Anglican soteriology per the 39 Articles.
score_notes.cultural: Church of Nigeria led GAFCON's resistance to TEC and ACoC innovations; founding mission of CONNAM is precisely to preserve orthodox Anglicanism in North America.
score_notes.denominational: CONNAM — Church of Nigeria North American Mission — successor body to CANA, GAFCON-aligned.
score_notes.preaching: Vigorous evangelical preaching in the global-south Anglican tradition.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Strong Nigerian-Anglican lay-leadership culture; men's fellowships are characteristic.
score_notes.mission: CONNAM is itself a foreign mission of the Church of Nigeria; Christ Anglican Marietta is a regional missionary hub.

churches.assessment: Christ Anglican Church, Marietta, Georgia, is led by the Right Reverend Celestine Ironna, Missionary Bishop of CONNAM's Southeast Missionary Region Area 1. The congregation is part of the Church of Nigeria North American Mission, the GAFCON-aligned successor to CANA. It upholds the 39 Articles and male-only holy orders in continuity with the Church of Nigeria.
churches.enrichment_notes: Added from CANA / CONNAM research; bishop's seat for CONNAM Southeast Missionary Region.

churches.assessment: Holy Trinity Anglican Cathedral in Houston, Texas, was consecrated in 2021 as the cathedral parish of the Anglican Diocese of the West (CONNAM). The cathedral serves as a center for the Church of Nigeria North American Mission's ministry across the southern United States. It upholds the 39 Articles and male-only holy orders.
